description: Logs a completed phone call as a task in Salesforce with call-specific details like duration, type, and disposition.

call_date.description: Date of the call in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if not specified.
call_date.human_parameter_description: The date the call happened (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank to use today’s date automatically.
call_date.title: Call Date

call_disposition.description: Outcome or result of the call. Restricted picklist — only org-configured values are accepted; unlisted values cause validation errors.
call_disposition.human_parameter_description: What happened on the call. Use a clear outcome like 'Contact Made' or 'Left Message' to summarize the result.
call_disposition.title: Call Disposition

call_duration_seconds.description: Duration of the call in seconds.
call_duration_seconds.human_parameter_description: How long the call lasted, in seconds. This helps measure talk time and reporting.
call_duration_seconds.title: Call Duration Seconds

call_type.description: Standard Salesforce Task CallType values. This is a restricted picklist.
call_type.human_parameter_description: How the call happened—Inbound, Outbound, or Internal. This is a restricted field that only accepts these three standard values.
call_type.title: CallTypeEnum

comments.description: Detailed notes or description of what was discussed during the call.
examples: Discussed product features and pricing. Customer interested in premium plan.
Resolved technical issue with login. Customer satisfied.
comments.human_parameter_description: Notes about what was discussed and any next steps. Include enough detail so teammates understand the context.
comments.title: Comments

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Call_Outcome__c').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide custom Salesforce fields to store org-specific call data. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

subject.description: Subject line for the call log. Defaults to 'Call'.
subject.human_parameter_description: A short title for the call log. Keep it descriptive so it’s easy to recognize on timelines and reports.
subject.title: Subject

what_id.description: ID of the related record (Account, Opportunity, Case, etc.) associated with the call.
what_id.human_parameter_description: The record this call is about (like an Account, Opportunity, or Case). Paste its Salesforce ID to attach the call to that record.
what_id.title: What Id

who_id.description: ID of the Contact or Lead associated with the call. Invalid or non-existent IDs create orphaned or mislinked activity records.
who_id.human_parameter_description: The person you spoke with. Paste the Salesforce Contact or Lead ID to link the call to their record for easy tracking.
who_id.title: Who Id

name: log_call

ErrorDetail.description: Details about an error that occurred during the API call.

errorCode.description: A specific error code identifier indicating the type of error (e.g., 'MALFORMED_ID', 'FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', 'REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING').
errorCode.title: Error Code

extendedErrorDetails.description: Additional detailed error information when available.
extendedErrorDetails.title: Extended Error Details

fields.description: Array of field names that caused the error. Present when the error is related to specific field(s).
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the error details.
message.title: Message

statusCode.description: HTTP status code or Salesforce-specific status code associated with the error.
statusCode.title: Status Code

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

LogCallResponse.description: Response from Salesforce after creating a Task record for logging a call.

errors.description: Array of error objects containing details about any errors that occurred. Empty array when the operation is successful.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The unique Salesforce ID of the newly created Task record. Returns an 18-character Salesforce record identifier when the call is successful. Null when the operation fails.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the API call was successful. Returns true when the Task record was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success

LogCallResponse.title: LogCallResponse
